0|2c810ccdbac434ae38f4ec5331d3f047dc90f98a|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"iwlwifi: rework broadcast station management
Currently
column2: the broadcast station is managed along

column1: with the interface type
present. That leads to a bug with injection -- it
is currently not possible to inject frames when
the only virtual interface is a monitor
in that the required broadcast station is missing.
Additionally
broadcast station's LQ all the time is wasteful
and the code to support this is fairly complex.
So this changes completely the way we manage the
broadcast station. Rather than manage it along
with any interface
column2: we now allocate it when we

column1: bring the device up
column2: and remove it again when we

column1: bring the device down. When we bring the device
up
column2: we don't immediately program the broadcast

column1: station into it
column2: instead we just mark it active

column1: and rely on the next restore cycle to upload it
to the device. This works because an unassociated
RXON is always required at least once to set up
device parameters
of stations into the device.
As we now manage all stations properly
longer is a need for forcing a clearing of them
via iwl_clear_ucode_stations()
a lot simpler.
